security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by JavaScript template literals, fixed relative asset references, and a minified third-party GSAP bundle. The audit identified a silent remote update command and unsafe handling of storyboard-controlled paths and HTML attributes; these require remediation before publication.

remediation.issue: The skill runs an unpinned npx update command silently.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic updates from the workflow. Ask for approval, pin the package version, and show the exact command before it runs.

remediation.issue: Frame source paths can escape the project directory.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve each frame source and reject it unless it is inside the resolved project frames directory. Reject absolute paths and traversal segments.

remediation.issue: Storyboard paths are interpolated into HTML attributes without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Validate frame filenames against a strict allowlist and HTML-escape every interpolated attribute value.

remediation.issue: Templates load third-party resources from CDNs.
remediation.suggestion: Vendor approved dependencies or pin versions with integrity metadata for every external script and stylesheet.

content.value_statement: Turning a track into a structured video requires timing, visual planning, and rendering steps. This skill guides Claude through a beat-aware HyperFrames workflow from audio analysis to a reviewed MP4.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes a supplied music track and writes a timing map with beats, energy phases, and audio events.
Creates a frame-based storyboard that tiles the track duration.
Plans kinetic typography, templates, motion primitives, and optional user media around the audio timing.
Stages supported local image and video assets for a project.
Assembles planned frame compositions with the background music into an index file.
Runs project checks, generates snapshots, and renders an MP4 after approval.
limitations: Requires Python packages, ffmpeg, and the HyperFrames CLI to be available.
Beat timing is less reliable for calm or weakly rhythmic music.
Does not create narration or capture websites.
Uses user-provided assets or typography; it does not guarantee licensed music or media.

use_cases.title: Produce a lyric video
use_cases.description: Turn a vocal track and timed lyrics into beat-aligned typography and frame treatments.

use_cases.title: Build a product music promo
use_cases.description: Combine a fast music track with supplied product images or clips for a short kinetic promo.

use_cases.title: Create a social visualizer
use_cases.description: Generate an asset-light visual video from a track and mood direction for social publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple music video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second landscape music video from my track. Use kinetic typography and no external visual assets.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a lyric video
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a portrait lyric video from my song. Use these lyrics and align each line to the strongest musical phrases.

prompt_templates.title: Use supplied media
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 20-second product music promo from my track and the images in this folder. Cut images on strong beats and keep text minimal.

prompt_templates.title: Direct an advanced sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second square video from this electronic track. Use phrase-flow during calm sections, beat cuts during drops, and show me the storyboard before rendering.

output_examples.input: A 30-second rhythmic track with no visual assets.
output: A timing map with beat and energy information.
A storyboard with frame durations and kinetic typography treatments.
A verified video project ready for rendering.

output_examples.input: A product track with six supplied images.
output: A frame plan that assigns images to beat-aligned groups.
A project index that mounts the frame compositions and background music.
Snapshots for review before MP4 rendering.

best_practices: Use music you have permission to analyze and publish.
Review the frame-by-frame storyboard before rendering.
Use phrase-based pacing when the track does not have a reliable beat.
anti_patterns: Do not use this workflow for narrated videos or website capture.
Do not force hard cuts on calm music with an unreliable beat grid.
Do not render before reviewing validation results and snapshots.

faq.question: What input does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a music track. You can also provide local images, video clips, lyrics, and a mood brief.

faq.question: Can it work without visual assets?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow can use typography, templates, and motion primitives without supplied media.

faq.question: Does it support lyric videos?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide timed lyrics or use an available transcription workflow to obtain line timing.

faq.question: When should I use phrase-flow pacing?
faq.answer: Use it for calm or weakly rhythmic music where the detected beat grid is not musically reliable.

faq.question: What software is required?
faq.answer: You need Python with the listed audio libraries, ffmpeg, Node.js, and the HyperFrames CLI.

faq.question: Does the skill publish the video?
faq.answer: No. It builds and renders a local MP4. You remain responsible for review and publishing.
